Throughout this policy, the following terms have the meanings stated below:

1.1 "Insurer" means Centennial Coastal Mutual, its successors and assigns.

1.2 "Insured" means the Named Insured and, if a resident of the residence premises, the following: (a) relatives of the Named Insured; (b) other persons under the age of 21 who are in the care of the Named Insured or a relative; and (c) full-time students, as defined below.

1.3 "Residence premises" means the dwelling, other structures, and grounds shown in the Declarations, or that part of any other building where the Named Insured resides, as shown in the Declarations.

1.4 "Bodily injury" means bodily harm, sickness, or disease, including required care, loss of services, and death.

1.5 "Property damage" means physical injury to, destruction of, or loss of use of tangible property.

1.6 "Occurrence" means an accident, including continuous or repeated exposure to substantially the same general harmful conditions, which results, during the policy period, in bodily injury or property damage.

1.7 "Business" means any trade, profession, or occupation engaged in on a full-time, part-time, or occasional basis, whether or not for profit, except when the activity is expressly covered under this policy.

1.8 "Claims handling authority" means the entity designated by the Insurer under the underwriting contract to investigate, evaluate, negotiate, and settle claims made under this policy. The claims handling authority acts on behalf of the Insurer for all purposes related to claim administration.

SECTION 2 – INSURING AGREEMENT

2.1 In consideration of the payment of the premium shown in the Declarations and in reliance upon the statements made by the Named Insured in the application, the Insurer agrees to provide the coverages described in this policy, subject to all terms, conditions, and limitations contained herein.

2.2 The Insurer does not waive any provision of this policy by performing any act or exercising any right not required by this policy.

The underwriting contract for Centennial Coastal Mutual designates Harborview Claims Services as the claims handling authority. Record status: current.

SECTION 3 – COVERAGE A – DWELLING

3.1 We cover the dwelling on the residence premises shown in the Declarations, including structures attached to the dwelling.

3.2 We cover:
a. Materials and supplies on the residence premises used to construct, alter, or repair the dwelling or other structures;
b. Building equipment and outdoor equipment used for the service of the dwelling, if owned by the Named Insured or acquired during the policy period;
c. The cost to remove and properly dispose of debris, as described in Section 9 – Additional Coverages.

3.3 We do not cover:
a. Land, including land on which the dwelling is located;
b. Trees, shrubs, plants, or lawns, except as provided in Section 9;
c. Personal property located in the dwelling that is otherwise covered under Coverage C.

3.4 Coverage A limit shown in the Declarations is the most we will pay for loss to the dwelling. This limit is not increased by the application of the replacement cost provision described in Section 9.

SECTION 4 – COVERAGE B – OTHER STRUCTURES

4.1 We cover other structures on the residence premises, separated from the dwelling by clear space, or connected to the dwelling only by a fence, utility line, or similar connection.

4.2 Structures used in whole or in part for business purposes are not covered, except as provided in Section 9.

4.3 The limit for Coverage B is 10% of the Coverage A limit, unless a different limit is shown in the Declarations.

SECTION 5 – COVERAGE C – PERSONAL PROPERTY

5.1 We cover personal property owned or used by an insured anywhere in the world.

5.2 At the Named Insured's request, we will cover personal property owned by:
a. Others while the property is on the residence premises;
b. A student insured while the property is at a residence occupied by the student, provided the student is under the age of 24 and has been a resident of the residence premises before moving to the school location.
SECTION 8 – PERILS INSURED AGAINST

8.1 We insure against direct physical loss to property described in Sections 3, 4, and 5, except as excluded or limited in this policy.

8.2 The following are not covered perils:
a. Ordinance or Law – enforcement of any ordinance or law regulating the construction, repair, or demolition of a building or other structure, except as provided in Section 9;
b. Earth Movement – including earthquake, landslide, mine subsidence, sinkhole, mudflow, or earth sinking, rising, or shifting;
c. Water Damage – including flood, surface water, waves, tidal water, overflow of a body of water, or spray from any of these, whether driven by wind or not; water or waterborne material from below the surface of the ground; or water or waterborne material carried by or otherwise from a sump pump, sump pump discharge, or a drain, whether the discharge is from a fixture or appliance;
d. Power Failure – failure of power or other utility service if the failure takes place away from the residence premises;
e. Neglect – the Named Insured's neglect to use all reasonable means to save and preserve property at and after the time of a loss;
f. War – including undeclared war, civil war, insurrection, rebellion, revolution, warlike act by a military force or military personnel, or destruction, seizure, or use for a military purpose;
g. Nuclear Hazard – nuclear reaction, radiation, or radioactive contamination, all whether controlled or uncontrolled, and the resulting loss to property;
h. Intentional Loss – any loss arising out of an act committed by or at the direction of the Named Insured with the intent to cause a loss.

8.3 We do not insure against loss to property described in Coverages A and B caused by any of the following, unless the loss is a direct result of fire or explosion:
a. Weather conditions that contribute to a peril excluded in 8.2;
b. Acts or decisions of any person, group, organization, or governmental body;
c. Faulty, inadequate, or defective planning, zoning, development, surveying, siting, design, specifications, workmanship, repair, construction, renovation, remodeling, grading, compaction, maintenance, or materials used in repair, construction, renovation, or remodeling.

SECTION 9 – ADDITIONAL COVERAGES

9.1 Debris Removal – We will pay the reasonable expense incurred by the Named Insured for the removal of debris of covered property if a covered loss occurs. This coverage is included in the limit applicable to the covered property. If the applicable limit is exhausted, we will pay up to an additional 5% of that limit for debris removal.

9.4 Fire Department Service Charge – We will pay up to $500 for a fire department service charge incurred when the fire department is called to save covered property from a peril insured against, if the charge is the responsibility of the Named Insured.

9.5 Property Removed – We will pay for covered property that is removed from the residence premises to protect it from a peril insured against, for up to 30 days while it is being removed or stored. This coverage does not increase the limit applicable to the property being removed.

9.6 Credit Card, Fund Transfer Card, Forgery, and Counterfeit Money – We will pay up to $1,000 for loss involving the Named Insured's credit cards or fund transfer cards issued to or registered in the Named Insured's name, or loss from forgery or alteration of any check or negotiable instrument, or loss from acceptance in good faith of counterfeit United States or Canadian paper currency. 2. We do not cover other structures used in whole or in part for business purposes, unless the business is conducted solely by the Named Insured or a resident of the residence premises and is limited to the rental of the structure to others not for use as a dwelling.

3. Special limits of liability apply to the following categories of property. These limits are the total limit for each category for each loss, regardless of the number of items or the number of insureds.

We will pay for any necessary increase in living expenses and fair rental value, less expenses that do not continue, for up to 24 months, if a civil authority prohibits access to the residence premises as a result of damage to neighboring premises by a peril insured against. **SECTION II – EXCLUSIONS**

**A. We do not cover loss caused directly or indirectly by any of the following. Such loss is excluded regardless of any other cause or event that contributes concurrently or in any sequence to the loss.**

1. **Ordinance or Law.** The enforcement of any ordinance or law that regulates the construction, repair, or demolition of a building or other structure, or that requires the repair, removal, or demolition of damaged property. We do, however, pay up to 10% of the Coverage A limit of liability for the increased cost to repair or rebuild the dwelling due to the enforcement of building codes, provided the loss is otherwise covered under this policy.

2. **Earth Movement.** Earthquake, including land shock waves or tremors before, during, or after a volcanic eruption; landslide; mine subsidence; mudflow; sinkhole; or any other earth movement, including the sinking, rising, or shifting of earth. This exclusion applies even if the earth movement is caused by fire, explosion, or another peril that is otherwise covered.

3. **Water Damage.** Flood, surface water, waves, tidal water, overflow of a body of water, or spray from any of these, whether or not driven by wind; water that backs up through sewers or drains; water that overflows from a sump pump, sump pump well, or other system designed to remove subsurface water; or water below the surface of the ground, including water that exerts pressure on, or seeps or leaks through, a building, sidewalk, driveway, foundation, swimming pool, or other structure. This exclusion does not apply to direct loss by fire, explosion, or theft resulting from the water damage.

4. **Power Failure.** Failure of power or other utility service if the failure occurs away from the residence premises. We do cover loss caused by a resulting fire, explosion, or theft.

5. **Neglect.** Neglect of the Named Insured to use all reasonable means to save and preserve property at and after the time of a loss.

6. **War.** War, including undeclared war, civil war, insurrection, rebellion, revolution, warlike act by a military force or military personnel, destruction or seizure or use for a military purpose, and including any consequence of any of these. Discharge of a nuclear weapon shall be deemed a warlike act, even if accidental.

7. **Nuclear Hazard.** Nuclear reaction, radiation, or radioactive contamination, all whether controlled or uncontrolled, and whether caused by natural or artificial means.

8. **Intentional Loss.** Any loss arising out of any act committed by or at the direction of the Named Insured with the intent to cause a loss.

**B. We do not cover loss to property described in Coverages A, B, and C caused by any of the following. However, any ensuing loss to property described in Coverages A, B, and C not excluded or excepted in this policy is covered.**

**SECTION III — CONDITIONS**

**A. Policy Period.** This policy applies only to loss or damage that occurs during the policy period. The policy period is shown on the Declarations page. No coverage exists for loss or damage that occurs before the policy period begins or after it ends, regardless of when the claim is reported.

**B. Cancellation.**

1. **Cancellation by You.** You may cancel this policy at any time by returning this policy to us or by giving us advance written notice. The cancellation will take effect on the date we receive your notice, or on the date you specify in the notice, whichever is later. If you cancel, we will return the pro rata premium for the remaining term of the policy. The return premium will be computed using the short-rate table in effect at the time of cancellation, unless you cancel because we have substantially increased the premium or reduced the coverage under this policy, in which case the return premium will be computed on a pro rata basis.

2. **Cancellation by Us.** This policy may be cancelled by us for one or more of the reasons stated below. We will mail you a written notice of cancellation at the address shown on the Declarations page. The notice will state the effective date of cancellation and the reason for cancellation. The effective date of cancellation will be no earlier than:

a. Ten days after the notice is mailed if we cancel for nonpayment of premium;
   b. Thirty days after the notice is mailed if we cancel for any other reason permitted by this policy or by law.

If we cancel, the return premium will be computed on a pro rata basis. You will receive the return premium no later than the effective date of cancellation, unless the premium has been financed under a premium finance agreement, in which case the return premium will be paid in accordance with that agreement.

3. **Reasons for Cancellation by Us.** We may cancel this policy:

a. For nonpayment of premium, including nonpayment of any installment or any amount due under a premium finance agreement;
   b. If you have made a material misrepresentation or concealed a material fact in obtaining this policy or in presenting a claim under it;
   c. If there has been a substantial change in the risk, other than a change in the risk that is a natural consequence of the passage of time, that increases the hazard insured against;
   d. If you or any insured under this policy has been convicted of an offense arising out of acts increasing the hazard insured against;
   e. If the policy was obtained through fraud or material misrepresentation;
   f. If we determine that the risk does not meet our underwriting standards, provided that we have not previously renewed the policy after acquiring knowledge of the facts that form the basis for this determination.

4. **Notice of Nonrenewal.** If we elect not to renew this policy, we will mail you a written notice of nonrenewal at least sixty days before the end of the policy period. If we fail to mail a timely notice of nonrenewal, you may renew the policy under the same terms and conditions for a period of sixty days from the end of the policy period, at the premium shown on the Declarations page unless the premium is otherwise adjusted in accordance with this policy.

5. **Effective Date of Cancellation or Nonrenewal.** The effective date of cancellation or nonrenewal will be stated in the notice. If the notice is mailed, the effective date will be determined as of the date the notice is postmarked. **ENDORSEMENT NO. 3 – REPLACEMENT COST VALUATION**

This endorsement modifies the policy to which it is attached. It is effective only if shown on the Declarations page or added by subsequent endorsement. All other terms and conditions of the policy remain unchanged.

**A. REPLACEMENT COST PROVISION**

With respect to Covered Property, we will pay the cost to repair or replace the damaged property with material of like kind and quality, without deduction for depreciation, subject to the following:

1. **When Payment Is Made.** We will pay the replacement cost only after the repair or replacement is completed. 2. **Time Limitation.** You must complete the repair or replacement within 365 days from the date of loss, unless we agree in writing to extend this period. If you fail to complete the repair or replacement within this period, and no extension has been granted, we will pay the actual cash value of the property as of the date of loss.

3. **Claim for Actual Cash Value.** You may make a claim for actual cash value and then later claim the additional amount due under this endorsement, provided you notify us of your intent to claim the additional amount within 180 days after the date of loss. The additional payment will be made only after the repair or replacement is completed.

4. **Limitation on Payment.** We will not pay more than the smallest of the following amounts:
   a. The Limit of Liability shown on the Declarations page for the covered property;
   b. The replacement cost of the damaged property, determined at the time of repair or replacement;
   c. The amount actually and necessarily spent to repair or replace the damaged property.

5. **No Pair or Set Clause.** If the damaged property consists of a pair or set, we will pay the replacement cost of the entire pair or set, but only if you repair or replace the entire pair or set. If you do not repair or replace the entire pair or set, we will pay the actual cash value of the damaged item only.

6. **Building Ordinance Coverage Not Affected.** This endorsement does not alter any coverage provided under the policy for the enforcement of building ordinances or laws. The cost to repair or replace will not include any amount required to comply with an ordinance or law regulating the construction, repair, or demolition of a building or other structure.

7. **Personal Property.** For personal property, replacement cost is the cost to repair or replace the article with a similar article of like kind and quality at the time of loss. We will not pay the cost of any betterment or upgrade unless such betterment or upgrade is necessary to restore the property to its pre-loss condition.

**B. CONDITIONS APPLICABLE TO THIS ENDORSEMENT**

1. **Our Right to Inspect.** We retain the right to inspect the damaged property and the completed repair or replacement before making any payment under this endorsement. You must permit us to inspect the property at reasonable times.

2. **Proof of Completion.** As a condition of payment, you must provide us with reasonable proof that the repair or replacement has been completed, including, where requested, copies of contracts, invoices, and receipts.

3. **No Abandonment.** This endorsement does not permit you to abandon damaged property to us. You remain responsible for protecting the property from further damage and for making reasonable and necessary temporary repairs.

4. **Effect on Other Coverage.** This endorsement does not increase the Limits of Liability shown on the Declarations page, nor does it extend coverage to property not otherwise covered under the policy. If other insurance applies to the loss, this endorsement does not alter the policy's provisions regarding other insurance.

5. **Dispute Resolution.** Any dispute arising under this endorsement is subject to the policy's appraisal and arbitration provisions, if any.

**SECTION II – EXCLUSIONS**

**A. We do not cover loss caused directly or indirectly by any of the following. Such loss is excluded regardless of any other cause or event that contributes concurrently or in any sequence to the loss.**

1. **Ordinance or Law.** The enforcement of any ordinance or law that regulates the construction, repair, or demolition of a building or other structure, or that requires the repair, removal, or demolition of damaged property. We do, however, pay up to 10% of the Coverage A limit of liability for the increased cost to repair or rebuild the dwelling due to the enforcement of building codes, provided the loss is otherwise covered under this policy.

2. **Earth Movement.** Earthquake, including land shock waves or tremors before, during, or after a volcanic eruption; landslide; mine subsidence; mudflow; sinkhole; or any other earth movement, including the sinking, rising, or shifting of earth. This exclusion applies even if the earth movement is caused by fire, explosion, or another peril that is otherwise covered.

3. **Water Damage.** Flood, surface water, waves, tidal water, overflow of a body of water, or spray from any of these, whether or not driven by wind; water that backs up through sewers or drains; water that overflows from a sump pump, sump pump well, or other system designed to remove subsurface water; or water below the surface of the ground, including water that exerts pressure on, or seeps or leaks through, a building, sidewalk, driveway, foundation, swimming pool, or other structure. This exclusion does not apply to direct loss by fire, explosion, or theft resulting from the water damage.

4. **Power Failure.** Failure of power or other utility service if the failure occurs away from the residence premises. We do cover loss caused by a resulting fire, explosion, or theft.

5. **Neglect.** Neglect of the Named Insured to use all reasonable means to save and preserve property at and after the time of a loss.

6. **War.** War, including undeclared war, civil war, insurrection, rebellion, revolution, warlike act by a military force or military personnel, destruction or seizure or use for a military purpose, and including any consequence of any of these. Discharge of a nuclear weapon shall be deemed a warlike act, even if accidental.

7. **Nuclear Hazard.** Nuclear reaction, radiation, or radioactive contamination, all whether controlled or uncontrolled, and whether caused by natural or artificial means.

8. **Intentional Loss.** Any loss arising out of any act committed by or at the direction of the Named Insured with the intent to cause a loss.

**B. We do not cover loss to property described in Coverages A, B, and C caused by any of the following. However, any ensuing loss to property described in Coverages A, B, and C not excluded or excepted in this policy is covered.**

1. **Weather.** Weather conditions. However, this exclusion only applies if weather conditions contribute in any way with a cause of loss excluded in Section II.A above to produce the loss.

2. **Acts or Decisions.** Acts or decisions, including the failure to act or decide, of any person, group, organization, or governmental body.

3. **Faulty, Inadequate, or Defective Planning, Construction, or Maintenance.** Planning, construction, or maintenance, whether on or off the residence premises, by any person, organization, or governmental body, of:
   a. A dwelling, structure, or other property;
   b. Materials used in construction or repair; or

**C. We do not cover loss caused by any of the following, regardless of whether any other cause or event contributes concurrently or in any sequence to the loss.**

**ENDORSEMENT NO. 3 – REPLACEMENT COST VALUATION**

This endorsement modifies the policy to which it is attached. It is effective only if shown on the Declarations page or added by subsequent endorsement. All other terms and conditions of the policy remain unchanged.

**A. REPLACEMENT COST PROVISION**

With respect to Covered Property, we will pay the cost to repair or replace the damaged property with material of like kind and quality, without deduction for depreciation, subject to the following:

1. **When Payment Is Made.** We will pay the replacement cost only after the repair or replacement is completed. If you do not repair or replace the damaged property, we will pay the actual cash value of the property at the time of loss, not to exceed the applicable Limit of Liability shown on the Declarations page.

2. **Time Limitation.** You must complete the repair or replacement within 365 days from the date of loss, unless we agree in writing to extend this period. If you fail to complete the repair or replacement within this period, and no extension has been granted, we will pay the actual cash value of the property as of the date of loss.

3. **Claim for Actual Cash Value.** You may make a claim for actual cash value and then later claim the additional amount due under this endorsement, provided you notify us of your intent to claim the additional amount within 180 days after the date of loss. The additional payment will be made only after the repair or replacement is completed.

4. **Limitation on Payment.** We will not pay more than the smallest of the following amounts:
   a. The Limit of Liability shown on the Declarations page for the covered property;
   b. The replacement cost of the damaged property, determined at the time of repair or replacement;
   c. The amount actually and necessarily spent to repair or replace the damaged property.

5. **No Pair or Set Clause.** If the damaged property consists of a pair or set, we will pay the replacement cost of the entire pair or set, but only if you repair or replace the entire pair or set. If you do not repair or replace the entire pair or set, we will pay the actual cash value of the damaged item only.

6. **Building Ordinance Coverage Not Affected.** This endorsement does not alter any coverage provided under the policy for the enforcement of building ordinances or laws. The cost to repair or replace will not include any amount required to comply with an ordinance or law regulating the construction, repair, or demolition of a building or other structure.

7. **Personal Property.** For personal property, replacement cost is the cost to repair or replace the article with a similar article of like kind and quality at the time of loss. We will not pay the cost of any betterment or upgrade unless such betterment or upgrade is necessary to restore the property to its pre-loss condition.

**B. CONDITIONS APPLICABLE TO THIS ENDORSEMENT**

1. **Our Right to Inspect.** We retain the right to inspect the damaged property and the completed repair or replacement before making any payment under this endorsement. You must permit us to inspect the property at reasonable times.

2. **Proof of Completion.** As a condition of payment, you must provide us with reasonable proof that the repair or replacement has been completed, including, where requested, copies of contracts, invoices, and receipts.

3. **No Abandonment.** This endorsement does not permit you to abandon damaged property to us. You remain responsible for protecting the property from further damage and for making reasonable and necessary temporary repairs.

4. **Effect on Other Coverage.** This endorsement does not increase the Limits of Liability shown on the Declarations page, nor does it extend coverage to property not otherwise covered under the policy. If other insurance applies to the loss, this endorsement does not alter the policy's provisions regarding other insurance.

5. **Dispute Resolution.** Any dispute arising under this endorsement is subject to the policy's appraisal and arbitration provisions, if any.

ADJUSTER'S NOTES – ADDENDUM TO INSPECTION FORM IF-2023-1187

This addendum is attached to and made part of Inspection Form IF-2023-1187, dated 2023-09-18, prepared by R. Calloway, Field Inspector, Pacific Crest Adjusting. The following notes and recommendations are supplemental to the inspection findings and estimate recorded in the main body of the form.

Adjuster's Notes:

1. The roof covering at the main dwelling consists of asphalt composition shingles, approximately 15 years old based on the condition of the shingles and the policyholder's statement that the roof was replaced in 2008. The visible damage documented in Section 4 of the inspection report is consistent with wind-driven hail impact, primarily concentrated on the south and west slopes of the main roof assembly.

2. The policyholder reported that the damage was first noticed following a hailstorm that passed through the area on the evening of Sept 14. The policyholder was not home at the time of the storm and did not observe the hail falling. Neighboring properties in the immediate vicinity show similar patterns of shingle damage, which supports the conclusion that the damage is weather-related rather than the result of normal aging or manufacturer defect.

3. The estimated damage amount recorded in Section 6 of this inspection form is $4,800.00. This estimate is preliminary and is based solely on the visible damage documented in the photographs referenced in Section 4. The estimate includes the cost of tear-off and replacement of the affected roof slopes, new underlayment, new flashing at the chimney and valley areas, and disposal of the old roofing material. No allowance has been made for damage that is not visible, including but not limited to damaged insulation, deteriorated roof sheathing, or mold growth.

4. The following items are specifically excluded from the preliminary estimate and should be evaluated during any re-inspection or supplemental review:

- Condition of the roof decking and sheathing beneath the shingle layer. If the decking is found to be rotted or otherwise compromised, additional replacement costs will apply.
   - Condition of the attic insulation. If the roofing is opened up and moisture or debris is found to have entered the attic space, the insulation may need to be removed and replaced.
   - Condition of the gutters and downspouts. The gutters were observed to be in fair condition at the time of inspection, but minor dents from hail impact were noted on the south side of the home. The gutters are not included in the current estimate.
   - Condition of the skylight on the north slope of the roof. The skylight appeared to be intact and showed no visible signs of damage, but a closer examination during the roof replacement may reveal hairline cracks or seal failure that was not visible from the ground or ladder.

5. The policyholder was advised that a re-inspection may be necessary after the roof covering is removed to confirm the final repair scope. The policyholder was also advised to obtain a second opinion from a licensed contractor if she wishes. The policyholder was cooperative throughout the inspection and provided access to the attic space, which allowed for a limited visual inspection of the underside of the roof decking. No active leaks or water staining were observed in the attic at the time of inspection.

6. Recommendation: A re-inspection is recommended after the roof covering has been removed by the contractor. The re-inspection should be performed by a field inspector or claims examiner to document the condition of the roof decking, underlayment, and flashing before the new roof covering is installed. Photographs of the exposed decking and underlayment should be taken for the claim file.

7. Recommendation: The contractor selected by the policyholder should be licensed and bonded in the State of Washington, and the contractor's license number should be recorded in the claim file prior to the start of work. The policyholder was provided with a list of questions to ask prospective contractors, including questions about licensing, insurance, and warranties.

INSPECTION SUMMARY

This is a preliminary damage assessment. The findings recorded on this form are based on a visual inspection of the exterior and interior of the subject property. The inspection was performed on the date noted above. This form is subject to review by the assigned claims examiner and to the results of a re-inspection if such a re-inspection is deemed necessary. No repairs have been authorized based solely on the contents of this form.

SECTION 1: POLICYHOLDER CONTACT

Policyholder was present during the inspection. Policyholder reported that the home is occupied year-round. Policyholder was cooperative and provided access to the attic space and all interior rooms. Policyholder reported no prior roof repairs or replacements in the last 10 years.

SECTION 2: STRUCTURE DESCRIPTION

- Structure Type: Single-family residence, two stories with attached garage.
- Year Built: Approximately 1998 (per county records).
- Roof Configuration: Gable with a moderate pitch. North slope faces the street; south slope faces the rear yard.
- Roof Covering: Asphalt composition shingles, architectural style. Estimated age of roof covering: 8-10 years.
- Siding: Hardboard lap siding, painted.
- Windows: Vinyl-frame double-hung.
- Chimney: Masonry, one chimney on the east side of the roof.

SECTION 3: VISIBLE DAMAGE OBSERVED

EXTERIOR - ROOF COVERING

- Multiple shingles on the south-facing slope show visible impact marks consistent with hail damage. The marks are circular and dark in appearance. Several shingles have lost granules, exposing the asphalt mat. A small cluster of shingles near the southeast corner of the roof shows cracking and splitting along the tab lines.
- The north-facing slope shows less visible damage, but a scattering of impact marks was noted near the ridge line. A single shingle near the ridge vent appeared to have a small puncture.
- The ridge vent itself was observed to be intact and did not show visible signs of impact damage. However, the ridge vent was not closely examined from the roof surface; observation was made from a ladder at the eave.
- The flashing around the chimney was observed to be in fair condition. The flashing material appears to be aluminum. No visible gaps or separations were noted at the time of inspection. The condition of the flashing under the shingles cannot be confirmed without removal of the adjacent shingles.

EXTERIOR - GUTTERS AND DOWNSPOUTS

- The gutters on the south side of the home show minor dents consistent with hail impact. The dents are small and do not appear to have compromised the function of the gutters. The gutters are not included in the current estimate.

EXTERIOR - SIDING

- The hardboard siding on the south and west elevations shows scattered impact marks consistent with hail. The marks are shallow and did not break the paint surface in most locations. A few locations on the west elevation show small dents where the siding may have been struck at an angle. No holes or cracks were observed in the siding. The siding damage appears to be cosmetic in nature.

EXTERIOR - WINDOWS

- No visible damage was observed to the window frames, glass, or screens. A small screen on the west side bedroom window was noted to have a small tear, but this appears to be pre-existing and unrelated to the storm event.

INTERIOR - ATTIC SPACE

- Limited visual inspection of the underside of the roof decking was performed from the attic access hatch. No active leaks or water staining were observed. The roof decking appeared to be dry at the time of inspection. The attic insulation is blown fiberglass and was observed to be in place.
